info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Deposit Lending By Param1-spec
info.description: This API enables users to retrieve detailed information about mortgage loans based on a specified parameter. Ideal for financial institutions, lenders, and developers, this service facilitates quick access to loan data, aiding in decision-making and customer service. By providing endpoint access to mortgage loan information, it supports functionality such as loan assessments and customer inquiries. Utilize this API to enhance user experiences and streamline lending operations.

get.description: Fetches the detailed information of the specified mortgage loan identified by its unique loan ID. This endpoint provides essential data including loan terms, interest rates, and borrower information.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving details of mortgage loan with ID LOAN-500045. Ensure that the request contains the necessary fields as per the defined schema.

200.description: The request was successful and the mortgage loan details are returned.

GetDepositLendingByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the mortgage loan operation with the specific loan identifier (LOAN-500045).
